messages:
Rebecca (Recruiter): Heads up  candidate Emily accepted L4 with $10k sign-on. She just asked to move start earlier to 2026-04-15 due to lease overlap. Can we accommodate?
Jamal (Hiring Manager): I can onboard earlier but need sign-on cash earlier. Any options?
Linda (People Ops): Two routes: (A) frontload 50% sign-on (comp exception + amendment + payroll PR) or (B) one-time relocation stipend. A is preferred by mgr and candidate.
Rebecca (Recruiter): Candidate prefers A and can sign amendment today.
PeopleOps-Bot: Created REQ-2026-1299 "Frontload sign-on for early start". Routing: Comp -> Legal -> Payroll. SLA 3bd.
Maya (Comp): Will review. Need manager note on attrition risk and confirmation base pay unchanged to fast-track.
Sanjay (Legal): No major contract issues. I can draft a short amendment with clawback for <90 days.
Payroll Bot: Note: to hit 2026-04-15 payroll we need PR and signed amendment by 2026-04-07 12:00 PT. Else next run 2026-05-01.
Linda (People Ops): Escalating to comp chair for expedited approval.
Maya (Comp): Approved. Attach manager justification + candidate signature.
Rebecca (Recruiter): Signed amendment attached. Payroll PR submitted. Candidate start confirmed 2026-04-15. Thanks everyone! :tada:
